name: opsbuddy-fix-full
description: Fully portable, end-to-end autonomous incident response for a failed Databricks job: opsbuddy-fix (11-phase orchestrator), databricks-debug (diagnosis + adversarial root-cause double-check), testing (static validation), and pr-review-opsbuddy-fix (Mode A PR review). Bundles its own Databricks MCP server (with a real .venv, no uv/PATH setup needed); GitHub and Jira are accessed through any already-connected MCP server for them. Installable and usable in any project.
